name: Nikto
summary: An open-source web server scanner which performs comprehensive tests against web servers for multiple items, including over 6700 potentially dangerous files/programs.
highlights: -Add-header — Add HTTP headers (can be used multiple times, one per header pair)
-check6 — Check if IPv6 is working (connects to ipv6.google.com or value set in nikto.conf)
-dbcheck — Check database and other key files for syntax errors
-list-plugins — List all available plugins, perform no testing

flags.name: -Add-header
flags.description: Add HTTP headers (can be used multiple times, one per header pair)

flags.name: -check6
flags.description: Check if IPv6 is working (connects to ipv6.google.com or value set in nikto.conf)

flags.name: -dbcheck
flags.description: Check database and other key files for syntax errors

flags.name: -followredirects

flags.description: Don't check for updates on startup

flags.description: Do not use cookies from responses in requests

flags.name: -nointeractive
flags.description: Disables interactive features

flags.name: -nolookup
flags.description: Disables DNS lookups

flags.name: -nossl
flags.description: Disables the use of SSL

flags.name: -nosslkeepalive
flags.description: Disable TLS connection reuse (keep-alive on by default)

flags.name: -noslash
flags.description: Strip trailing slash from URL (e.g., '/admin/' to '/admin')

flags.name: -no404
flags.description: Disables nikto attempting to guess a 404 page

flags.name: -Option
flags.description: Over-ride an option in nikto.conf, can be issued multiple times

flags.name: -Save
flags.description: Save positive responses to this directory ('.' for auto-name)

flags.name: -ssl
flags.description: Force ssl mode on port

flags.name: -Userdbs
flags.description: Load only user databases, not the standard databases all Disable standard dbs and load only user dbs tests Disable only db_tests and load udb_tests

flags.name: -useragent
flags.description: Force User-Agent instead of pulling from database

flags.name: -useproxy
flags.description: Use the proxy defined in nikto.conf, or argument http://server:port

flags.name: -Version
flags.description: Print plugin and database versions

flags.name: -404code
flags.description: Ignore these HTTP codes as negative responses (always). Format is "302,301".

flags.name: -404string
flags.description: Ignore this string in response body content as negative response (always). Can be a regular expression. + requires a value
